newsitem.title: USA: Service Merchandise Q4 same-store sales fall.
newsitem.headline: Service Merchandise Q4 same-store sales fall.

text.p: Service Merchandise Co Inc's fourth quarter same-store sales have fallen in the mid- to low single digits and same-store sales in December "were essentially flat," the company said in a phone message updating its results.
Service Merchandise acknowledged that it had softer than planned sales and inventories will end the year above its plans.
The company's fourth quarter ended December 29, 1996 and it will report its results in January.
Service Merchandise shares fell 1/2 to 4 today on 1.6 million shares of volume. The stock had touched a low of 3-7/8 during trading today.
Service Merchandise, a catalog showroom retailer that also operates the Kids Central USA stores, hit a recent high of 6-1/2 during trading on December 12, a high not seen since October 1995.
